record.title: Simulated closed etch cell: recipe, runs, traces, metrology, sort
record.description: 100 wafers through two simulated etchers under EWMA run-to-run control, with CD-SEM sampling, advisory virtual metrology and per-die sort. All values simulated by openie-fpga.
